title: Save your money
text: Save your money. I probably will be returning these. I have tried each scent. They scent last between 1 and 2 hours.

product_metadata.title: 3 Pack Soy Blend Wickless Candle Bar Wax Melts - Summer Scents - One Package Each of Summertime (Coconut), Love Potion (Fruity Perfume) , and Ecstasy (a Fun, Fruity and Floral Scent)
features: Wickless candles made with our own blend of several different waxes, primarily soy. Set includes one pack of Ecstasy (a fruity floral scent), one pack of Summertime (think Pina Coladas and Suntan Oil), and one pack of Love Potion (similar to the popular perfume). These are great scents no matter what the season!
Melts at a lower temperature than paraffin
6 cubes (3 oz) per pack for a total of 18 cubes all packaged in an attractive box. Highly scented to ensure a long lasting, strong scent
Can be used with any electric warmer, or with our Coo Candles
